messages:
mike: Quick favor — can someone run a smoke + p99 latency sweep for paladin-8b-v1 on g5.12x and a100-sXM before EOD? We need steady-state latency and perf counters. I pushed model to canary tag: models/paladin/v1/canary. Test config: seq 128/512, batch sizes 1/8/32, sampling temp 0.0 (greedy).

ashley: assigning to eng-runtime bench queue. @benchbot can you schedule? Also include KV cache warmup 1000 tokens and capture perftrace.

benchbot: Scheduled run #38471 for paladin-8b-v1 on g5.12x (ETA ~45m) and a100-sXM (ETA ~1h). Artifacts will post to s3://redwood-bench/paladin/v1/38471/

raju: noted. I'll capture perf counters (L2, memory ops) and set perftrace=on.

mike: thanks. Also enable quant-mode=fp16 and quant-mode=int8 for comparison.

benchbot: Run #38471 started on g5.12x. Command: `bench run --model paladin-8b-v1 --seq 512 --batches 1,8,32 --quant fp16,int8 --warmup 1000 --trace perf`

liz: doing a quick smoke now on dev cluster, saw no OOM on fp16 but int8 had rare kernel mismatch in step 3. Logging stacktrace.

mike: thx liz — can you paste the stacktrace? Might be kernel codepath mismatch.

liz: `RuntimeError: CUDA kernel failed at aten::matmul ... file kernel.cu:452` (short paste). Opening bug: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/6723

taylor: FYI I repro'd locally with int8, it's likely a fused attention kernel that doesn't support quant scale for paladin arch. I'll roll a patch and run regression.

benchbot: Run #38471 completed for g5.12x. Results: steady_p50: 42ms, p95: 88ms, p99: 126ms, throughput(b=32): 780 tok/s. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/paladin/v1/38471/g5.12x/results.json

benchbot: Run #38472 completed for a100-sXM. Results: steady_p50: 37ms, p95: 74ms, p99: 115ms, throughput(b=32): 980 tok/s. Artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/paladin/v1/38472/a100-sXM/results.json

raju: uploaded perf traces to s3://redwood-bench/paladin/v1/38471/perf_traces/38471.tar.gz. Early look: L2 miss rate slightly higher on paladin vs our reference model (~6% vs ~3%). Might be attention layout causing extra mem ops.

mike: good catch. Can you add a tiled attention layout experiment? set tile=32,64 and rerun with small batch.

benchbot: Scheduled run #38473 (tile=32,64, small-batches) on g5.12x (ETA ~30m).

liz: quick note: int8 kernel failure only on a100-sXM during larger batches, small batches are OK.

taylor: pushing a fix to fused-attn branch, will trigger CI. @mike if green, can we re-run int8 bench?

mike: yes please. prioritize correctness patch first.

benchbot: Run #38473 completed. tile=64 improved p99 by ~8% on g5.12x but increased p50 by ~4ms. Results artifacts: s3://redwood-bench/paladin/v1/38473/results_summary.txt

mike: summary: paladin-8b-v1 onboard smoke -> a100-sXM shows ~15% lower median latency than g5.12x; tile=64 reduces tail but bumps median slightly. int8 unstable on a100 for large batches; taylor is on a fix. Next steps: merge fused-attn patch, re-run int8, publish bench summary to docs and open canary rollout at 10%.

ashley: I'll open a docs PR and add release notes + canary checklist.

mike: thanks everyone :rocket:
